events.body:
## Context

BLT-Dash (`blt-dash/`) is rated **Bronze** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-dash): it meets 86% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Silver (it runs: tests in CI, an automatic deploy, a live site and steps to run it)

- **Tests run in CI.** Add automated tests and a row for the folder in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`, so every pull request runs them (`scripts/ci/test.sh blt-dash`).

### Gold (it is looked after: the BLT theme, a contributing guide, recent commits, several contributors and triaged issues)

- **Contributing guide.** Add CONTRIBUTING.md (or a Contributing section in the README): how to set up, test, and open a pull request on git.owaspblt.org, linking the root CONTRIBUTING.md and AI_POLICY.md.

## Notes

- The README describes live NIST scores, a green/cyan theme and a scan-line overlay, but the data is hard-coded and the site is now on the BLT theme; update it, and fix `cd BLT-Dash` (the folder is `blt-dash`).
- In `src/index.py` the `/dash` prefix is stripped from the path but the original request is served, so the strip does nothing.
- The `lint` script in package.json is a stub, and `src/__pycache__/` needs a `.gitignore`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tests run in CI
- [ ] Contributing guide
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-dash` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-dash
scripts/ci/test.sh <your folder>
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
